issues.rationale: The @supabase/ssr browser client uses PKCE, but invite and recovery emails are redirected directly to the client page without a token_hash and verifyOtp server callback. The current implementation has no PKCE verifier for these server-initiated emails and the initial setup or reset link can fail before a valid cookie session is established.
issues.fix: Add a cookie-capable server confirmation route that validates invite and recovery token_hash values with verifyOtp, update the corresponding Supabase email templates to target it, and add realistic callback integration tests.

issues.rationale: Staff session resolution filters only by auth_user_id and active state. Because it uses a service-role client, a stale cross-organization staff link can produce a valid context for a profile from another organization and expose or mutate data through downstream service-role queries.
issues.fix: Require staff.organization_id to equal profile.organization_id when resolving the context, fail closed on mismatches, audit existing links before rollout, and add a cross-organization regression test.

issues.rationale: The page accepts any authenticated and linked staff session without proving that the current navigation completed a fresh invite or recovery verification. Direct, expired, or reused URLs therefore do not satisfy the documented fail-closed intent.
issues.fix: Bind the page to a freshly verified invite or recovery callback and consume or clear the authorization after password update.

issues.rationale: Owners can edit staff.email after Auth linkage without updating the Auth user or user_profiles.email. Password reset then fails with inconsistent_profile and there is no supported recovery path.
issues.fix: Make linked email immutable or implement a coordinated, confirmed email-change workflow with compensation across Auth, user_profiles, and staff.

issues.rationale: writeAuditLog ignores insert errors, so a security-sensitive operation can report success without its audit record.
issues.fix: Propagate the audit insert error or record an explicit partial-success state with a retryable audit path, and test audit insertion failure.

issues.rationale: Repeated invite and reset controls have identical accessible names and the result message has no status or alert semantics, so assistive technology cannot reliably identify the target or announce the outcome.
issues.fix: Include the staff name in each action aria-label and expose success or failure through role=status or role=alert.

issues.rationale: The ledger still describes Round 2 verification and Round 3 request as future work after both have completed, so a resumed agent can repeat completed actions.
issues.fix: Synchronize the ledger with the Round 3 fail-close state when the blocking fix work resumes.
